text:
Iron is extracted from hematite in the blast furnace.
Which reaction increases the temperature in the blast furnace to over 1500°C?
calcium carbonate → calcium oxide + carbon dioxide
A
calcium oxide + silicon(IV) oxide → calcium silicate
B
carbon + oxygen → carbon dioxide
C
carbon dioxide + carbon → carbon monoxide
D

options.label: A
options.text: calcium carbonate → calcium oxide + carbon dioxide

options.label: B
options.text: calcium oxide + silicon(IV) oxide → calcium silicate
